verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's Release Pipelines let you define stages with 'triggers and actions' that automatically progress flags to environments/audiences, and Scheduled Flags apply changes automatically at a set time, both of which are rule-based automated actions. However, this is scoped to flag-rollout workflows rather than a general event-driven automation engine (e.g., no evidence of arbitrary event listeners triggering external actions beyond audit-log webhook exports). Missing for 10: evidence of broader/general-purpose event-to-action automation (e.g., custom triggers on external events, not just release-stage or time-based triggers), and independent confirmation of Release Pipeline reliability.
